description: USE FOR DEBUGGING declarative (the '85 debug module) - deleted by ISO 2002 with the whole facility (DEBUG-* registers included), absent from ISO 2023. MODELED at --std 85 (the ON procedure-name / ALL PROCEDURES trigger leg + the DEBUG-ITEM register; object-time switch RunUnit.DebugMode default ON): without WITH DEBUGGING MODE the debugging section is comment-treated (the '85 rule); with it, the declarative fires before each subject procedure. Rejected COBOL0902 at >=2002. Companion of debugging-mode-removed-2002.
citation: the '85 debug module's declarative, deleted by ISO 2002 with the whole facility incl.
